# Capesee

> A field guide to the Cape: living discoveries, source-backed history and local experiences, all connected to place.

## Primary
- [Discover](https://www.capesee.com/discover): Field guide home
- [Living Map](https://www.capesee.com/discover/map): Interactive discovery map
- [Places](https://www.capesee.com/discover/places): Verified places
- [Gallery](https://www.capesee.com/discover/gallery): 70+ field captures
- [Tours](https://www.capesee.com/book/tours): Bookable Cape experiences

## Places
- [Castle of Good Hope](https://www.capesee.com/discover/places/castle-of-good-hope)
- [Kirstenbosch](https://www.capesee.com/discover/places/kirstenbosch)
- [Stellenbosch](https://www.capesee.com/discover/places/stellenbosch)
- [Hermanus](https://www.capesee.com/discover/places/hermanus)
